5.10.5. The System Catalog Schema
In addition to public and user-created schemas, each database contains a pg_catalog
schema, which contains the system tables and all the built-in data types, functions, and operators.
pg_catalog is always effectively part of the search path. If it is not named explicitly in the path
then it is implicitly searched before searching the path's schemas. This ensures that built-in names will
always be findable. However, you can explicitly place pg_catalog at the end of your search path
if you prefer to have user-defined names override built-in names.
